summary: Phase 11 High-End Visual Asset Redesign - Comprehensive Regression Test Complete. All backend APIs (7/7) and frontend features tested successfully. Visual overhaul (terrain textures, buildings, creatures, staff, guests, lighting/atmosphere in /app/frontend/src/game/art/) renders correctly without breaking gameplay, UI, or backend. Canvas rendering verified with 2M+ pixels. Creature acquisition, staff hiring, build toolbar, time controls, and save/load all working. Only 1 minor performance warning (Canvas2D willReadFrequently). NO GAMEPLAY BREAKING BUGS FOUND.
